ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious pool type returns inflated amountOut to drain LP reserves
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 validates actual token receipt. Reserve decrement via _safeDecrementUint128 at L1437 reverts on underflow. Protocol fee validation at L1654-1677 enforces minimums. actualAmountIn validated <= originalAmountIn at L1405. Per-pool reserve isolation prevents cross-pool drainage.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious transfer handler skips actual token transfer
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Balance check at AMMModule.sol:2208 — balanceInBefore + amountIn == balanceInAfter. Handler MUST transfer actual tokens. Both CLOB and Permit handlers validate msg.sender == AMM.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Malicious hook returns excessive swap fees to siphon from swappers
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fees bounded at AMMModule.sol:2616 (if feeAmount > swapAmountIn revert) and L2628, L2711, L2723. For liquidity ops, bounded by user-specified maxHookFee. All hooks enforce _requireCallerIsAMM() preventing direct invocation.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Register pool type at vanity address with 6 leading zero bytes to create malicious pool
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Anyone can create pools with custom pool types (Tier B). But pool type only controls swap math for its own pool. Reserves isolated per pool. Balance checks validate transfers. LPs/swappers choose which pool to use. Token hooks can whitelist allowed pool types.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Storage-slot collision via malicious extension writing to AMM's diamond storage
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All extensions (pool types, hooks, handlers) called via call not delegatecall. They execute in their own storage context. Only internal modules use delegatecall with immutable constructor addresses.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Multi-hop cross-pool extraction via malicious pool type at one hop
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Output of hop N becomes input of hop N+1 (AMMModule.sol:1469). Reserve decrements at L1437/L1440 prevent extracting more than deposited. Attacker would only trade with themselves.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Flash loan cross-token fee exploitation via malicious token hook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Requires malicious token hook (set by token owner/admin). Fee token hook can validate via FLASHLOANS_VALIDATE_FEE_FLAG. Users choose which tokens to flash loan from. Self-inflicted risk.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Direct hook invocation (forged hook caller) to claim fees without swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All hook entry points guarded by _requireCallerIsAMM() at AMMStandardHook.sol:940-943 using immutable AMM address. Cannot bypass.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transient storage theft (read stale slot from different operation)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known Low (CP-001/HOOK-001). By-design: beforeSwap writes transient slot per-token, second call overwrites first. No extraction path beyond documented finding.
feeOnTop not in SWAP_TYPEHASH but limitAmount IS signed and caps total exposure. Known Low finding. Executor can set feeOnTop but cannot exceed limitAmount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dust-loop extraction via 100+ tiny swaps accumulating rounding errors
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: FeeHelper.sol uses mulDiv (rounds down against attacker for input fees) and mulDivRoundingUp (rounds up for LP fees). No profitable dust accumulation path.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Dynamic pool fee manipulation via malicious pool hook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Dynamic fee validated at AMMModule.sol:1717 — cannot exceed MAX_BPS for input swaps, MAX_BPS-1 for output. Pool hook fixed at pool creation. Tier B.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Single provider pool price manipulation via malicious pricing hook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Price validated against MIN/MAX_SQRT_RATIO (wide range). But pool hook set at creation by creator. Swappers voluntarily choose pool. Tier B.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Transfer handler callback exploitation after swap finalization
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Callback data generated by handler during ammHandleTransfer. Callback executed after finalization. Handler validates msg.sender == AMM. Handler can only modify its own state.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Hook fee reentrancy via collectHookFeesByHook during swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Fee collection during swap is QUEUED (ModuleFeeCollection.sol:75-76), not executed immediately. Processed via executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers called by AMM self-call (msg.sender == address(this)). No reentrancy.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: CREATE2 deploy-destroy-redeploy at trusted extension address
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Solidity 0.8.24 + Cancun EVM — selfdestruct is deprecated (only transfers ETH, does not destroy code). Cannot redeploy at same address.

theft_theses.thesis: Malicious pool type returns inflated amountOut to drain LP reserves via swap
theft_theses.victim: LPs who added liquidity to the malicious pool

theft_theses.thesis: Malicious transfer handler skips token transfer while core believes funds arrived
theft_theses.victim: AMM protocol (output tokens sent without input received)

theft_theses.thesis: Malicious hook charges excessive fees to extract value from swappers
theft_theses.victim: Swappers trading tokens with malicious hook
theft_theses.asset: Swap input/output amounts beyond fair fees
